close_reason: Deferred: ~24 construction sites + ~14 test assertions across 4 files; MtaStsError is internal and not exposed. TLSRPT (RFC 8460) is out of v1 scope — revisit when wiring TLSRPT where PolicyFetchFailed sub-reason discrimination matters.
description: mta_sts_error.rs: PolicyFetchFailed(String), PolicyParseFailed(String), DnsTxtInvalid(String), TlsCertInvalid(String) wrap free-form strings. Callers cannot match on specific sub-reasons without string parsing. When TLSRPT (RFC 8460) needs to classify failures by type, these variants are insufficient — a certificate error and a timeout both produce PolicyFetchFailed(String). Contrast with structured PolicyIdMismatch { cached, dns } and MxNotMatched { mx }. Not blocking while MtaStsError is internal, but adds friction when wiring TLSRPT.
title: MtaStsError string-message variants lose structured context for TLSRPT callers
